content.content:
=== .ansible-lint
---
profile: production
exclude_paths:
  - .git/
=== Makefile
.PHONY: lint test

lint:
	ansible-lint .

test: lint
	molecule test -s default
=== meta/runtime.yml
---
requires_ansible: ">=2.15"
=== molecule/default/converge.yml
---
- name: Converge
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Apply the nftables base role
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: platform.firewall.nftables_base
=== molecule/default/molecule.yml
---
driver:
  name: docker
platforms:
  - name: debian-bookworm
    image: debian:bookworm
provisioner:
  name: ansible
=== roles/nftables_base/defaults/main.yml
---
nftables_default_policy: drop
nftables_allowed_tcp_ports:
  - 22
nftables_ruleset_path: /etc/nftables.conf
=== roles/nftables_base/handlers/main.yml
---
- name: Reload nftables
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: nftables
    state: reloaded
=== roles/nftables_base/meta/main.yml
---
galaxy_info:
  role_name: nftables_base
  author: platform
  description: Applies a base nftables ruleset.
  license: MIT
  min_ansible_version: "2.15"
  platforms:
    - name: Debian
      versions:
        - bookworm
  galaxy_tags:
    - firewall
dependencies: []
=== roles/nftables_base/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Install nftables
  ansible.builtin.package:
    name: nftables
    state: present

- name: Write the ruleset
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: |
      table inet filter {
        chain input {
          type filter hook input priority 0; policy {{ nftables_default_policy }};
        }
      }
    dest: "{{ nftables_ruleset_path }}"
  notify: Reload nftables

- name: Load the ruleset now
  ansible.builtin.command: nft -f {{ nftables_ruleset_path }}

- name: Check the active ruleset
  ansible.builtin.shell: nft list ruleset | wc -l
  register: nftables_rule_lines

cat > galaxy.yml <<'E'

homepage: https://github.com/platform/firewall
issues: https://github.com/platform/firewall/issues

  - networking
  - security
  - linux
build_ignore:
  - .git
E
cat > CHANGELOG.md <<'E'
# Changelog

## 1.2.0

- Current release of the `nftables_base` role.
E
cat > meta/runtime.yml <<'E'
---
requires_ansible: ">=2.17.0"
E
sed -i 's/nftables_/nftables_base_/g' roles/nftables_base/defaults/main.yml
sed -i 's/min_ansible_version: "2.15"/min_ansible_version: "2.17"/; /^    - name: Debian/i\    - name: EL\n      versions:\n        - all' roles/nftables_base/meta/main.yml
cat > roles/nftables_base/tasks/main.yml <<'E'
---
- name: Install nftables
  ansible.builtin.package:
    name: nftables
    state: present

- name: Write the ruleset
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: |
      table inet filter {
        chain input {
          type filter hook input priority 0; policy {{ nftables_base_default_policy }};
          ct state established,related accept
          iif lo accept
      {% for port in nftables_base_allowed_tcp_ports %}
          tcp dport {{ port }} accept
      {% endfor %}
        }
      }
    dest: "{{ nftables_base_ruleset_path }}"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  notify: Reload nftables

- name: Load the ruleset now
  ansible.builtin.command: nft -f {{ nftables_base_ruleset_path }}
  changed_when: false

- name: Check the active ruleset
  ansible.builtin.shell: set -o pipefail && nft list ruleset | wc -l
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  register: nftables_base_rule_lines
  changed_when: false
E
cat roles/nftables_base/meta/main.yml roles/nftables_base/defaults/main.yml
ansible-lint . 2>&1 | tail -20

content.text:
`make test` did not pass. Lint passes, but the molecule scenario fails because of the environment, so I couldn't verify the role against a container.

**What I fixed**
- **`galaxy.yml`**
  - Added `repository`, `documentation`, `homepage` and `issues`, all pointing at the GitHub URL from the README.
  - Added `tags`: networking, security and linux.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: new file. `galaxy[no-changelog]` required one.
- **`meta/runtime.yml`**: `requires_ansible` raised from `>=2.15` to `>=2.17.0`, because 2.15 is no longer a supported version for the linter.
- **`roles/nftables_base/defaults/main.yml` and `tasks/main.yml`**: renamed all variables to use the `nftables_base_` prefix.
- **`roles/nftables_base/tasks/main.yml`**
  - The ruleset file now has an owner, group and mode (`0644`).
  - The `nft -f` command and the rule-count check now have `changed_when: false`.
  - The pipe in the shell task now sets `pipefail`.
  - The ruleset template previously ignored `allowed_tcp_ports`, so with a drop policy it would have locked out SSH. It now loops over the ports, and I also added loopback and established/related accepts.
- **`roles/nftables_base/meta/main.yml`**
  - `min_ansible_version` is now 2.17.
  - Added an EL platform entry, since the README says RedHat is supported. The role has not been tested on RedHat.

The `.ansible-lint` configuration is unchanged.

**Test result**
- **`ansible-lint .`**: passes the `production` profile with 0 failures. It started with 12.
- **`molecule test -s default`**: fails. The docker driver's `destroy.yml` and `create.yml` stop with "Failed to import the required Python library (requests)" on `/tmp/eval-tools/ansible-core/bin/python`. Molecule's own interpreter is a different Python from the one ansible-core runs under.
- **Not checked**: converge, idempotence and the role's behaviour in a container never ran.

To get a full run, install `requests` (and the `docker` Python library) into the ansible-core environment, or point molecule at an interpreter that has them. I didn't change the tool environment myself. After that, `make test` should be rerun.
